exposure: Standardised longitudinal reporting of growth monitoring information
outcome: Antenatal detection of fetal growth restriction (FGR) among small for gestational age (SGA) births
Number of antenatal visits and ultrasounds
finding: Serial plotting of symphysis-fundal height and estimated fetal weight measurements on customised growth charts did not improve the antenatal detection of FGR among SGA births.
birth_weight: Below the tenth centile of French customised curves
